title: Pattern and Frequency of Non-epileptic Involuntary Movements
brief_summary: We will perform a medical record review of all patients seen in Assiut University hospital, Egypt, to determine the frequency of movement disorders seen, disease characteristics, diagnostic evaluations.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with movement disorders attending Assiut University neurology outpatient clinic and internal department, from Jan 2020 to Jan 2021.

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1\) involuntary movements epileptic in origin 2) refusal of patient to give consent to join the study
study_population:
Patients with movement disorders attending Assiut University neurology outpatient clinic and internal department, from Jan 2020 to Jan 2021.
